definition.label: Configure an object's drawing tip
definition.description: Give any created/imported object one saved drawing tip, or remove it. Empty part means its root; otherwise use a stable recipe part. Local +Z points toward the drawing patch. Ink colour and radius are independent of object paint and tray pencil preferences. Radius uses the receiving patch's local metres. The enabled tip draws only while a user or Maestro holds the tool and its tip is within one world centimetre of an enabled plane/cylinder/sphere patch. Optional mode is draw (default) or erase. A held eraser sweeps complete strokes within twice its radius (minimum 1 cm) plus ink thickness; contact loss or release saves the selected IDs with one Undo. The preview hides selected ink while accepted source remains unchanged until save. Interrupted or failed erasing is retained for the same explicit retry/discard; no automatic deletion retry. Loose tools do not draw or erase. No arbitrary-mesh, skin or scanned-wall painting. One room capture at a time; loss of contact ends one saved stroke/Undo. After interruption or a busy/failed capture, separate the tip before starting again. Failed saves retain the draft for explicit retry/discard. Manual holding uses control priority; Maestro holding uses program priority and cannot interrupt a user. Configuration does not itself create ink or move objects. Copy, Undo, temporary rooms and portable workspaces retain the same tip data. Outside temporary play, prepares and publishes its save in the background with one Undo edit. Completion confirms native application and saving. Once preparation begins, newer authored changes invalidate its candidate. Cancellation before native acceptance leaves the requested edit unapplied. After acceptance, stopping cannot retract the edit or its pending save. A save conflict preserves files, blocks further saves and requires inspection; never blindly replay it. Runtime clock and viewer movement continue. Concurrent persisted object edits enter preparation in arrival order after earlier saves drain, without copying a waiting candidate. Stopping or invalidating a waiter releases its place; target changes while waiting require a new request. In a temporary room, changes the live room and local Undo; a kept snapshot makes it durable. Other objects keep running.

definition.label: Saved object definition
definition.description: Canonical object metadata and exact authored revision, from the temporary fork when active. Position/rotation/scale are saved room-local values, not live physics, camera coordinates or the animated pose. Content counts describe stored drawings, recipe parts and recorded frames; modelHash is an exact asset reference, not proof of availability or completed loading. Saved metadata remains readable when the native instance is inactive or unavailable. Use object.presence to distinguish that condition from missing saved content. Name is bounded display text; an empty copy name retains the original full name. Reading grants no edit authority and takes no ownership. Use this revision for kind=copy; a missing source is unavailable.
